Aunt Julie's Egg Chili Puff

.cook
👥 4 servings ⏱️ Prep Time: 10 minutes 🔥 Cook Time: 30 minutes 📖 Aunt Julie

🥘 Ingredients

  • chopped green chilies
    4 oz
  • cottage cheese
    1 cup
  • eggs
    5
  • flour
    1/4 cup
  • non-stick cooking spray
  • salt
    1/2 tsp
  • shredded cheddar cheese
    1/2 lbs

🍳 Cookware

  • large bowl
  • 8x8 inch baking dish
  1. 1
    Combine eggs , flour , salt , cottage cheese , shredded cheddar cheese , and chopped green chilies in a large bowl and mix well.
    eggs: 5, flour: 1/4 cup, salt: 1/2 tsp, cottage cheese: 1 cup, shredded cheddar cheese: 1/2 lbs, chopped green chilies: 4 oz
  2. 2
    Pour into a 8x8 inch baking dish sprayed with non-stick cooking spray . Bake at 350 F for ⏱️ 30 minutes until the center is set.
    non-stick cooking spray
  3. 3
    Serve with salsa or avocado.
